summary: Massive overnight drone assault involving 108 Shahed-type drones targeted Ukraine, with 82 shot down and hits on 11 locations. US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Moscow for peace talks, with Putin ordering a 3-day Kyiv strike suspension during their visit, while the Kremlin signaled no retreat from military objectives. Tu-95MS bombers redeployed toward launch positions, indicating preparation for another massive missile strike.
key_points: 108 Shahed-type drones (incl. reactive, Gerber, Parodia imitators, 6 S8000 Banderol) launched from Millerovo, Orel, Kursk, TOT Donetsk, Gvardiyske-TOT Crimea; 82 shot down, 11 locations hit (Source: @kpszsu/76746)
US envoys Witkoff and Kushner arrived in Moscow for peace talks; Kyiv and Moscow agreed mutual strike pause for safe passage; envoys expected in Kyiv Sept 6 (Source: @UkraineNow/83916)
Putin ordered no strikes on Kyiv for 3 days due to US negotiator visit; Peskov confirmed suspension (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33031)
Tu-95MS redeployed from Far East to Engels then Olenya airbase; 5 more armed in Far East; next massive missile strike likely end of next week (Source: @eRadarrua/111094)
Threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launch detected from Taganrog, Rostov region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73799)
Ukrainian F-16 pilots forced to engage only with onboard cannon, conserving AIM-9 Sidewinder and AIM-120 AMRAAM missiles (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33037)
Southern Group drone operators involved in liberation of Kurtovka in DPR (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33032)
Kremlin refuses to abandon military objectives; Putin ready to end war only on his terms; Ushakov cited Russian army 'tangible successes' (Source: @UkraineNow/83918)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia launched 108 Shahed-type drones overnight from multiple axes (Millerovo, Orel, Kursk, Donetsk, Crimea), indicating sustained high-tempo aerial campaign. Iskander-M threat from Taganrog and Tu-95MS redeployment signal preparation for another massive missile strike. F-16 ammunition conservation suggests Ukrainian air defense is under severe strain. The Kremlin's refusal to abandon military objectives despite US diplomatic engagement indicates negotiations may stall.
sections.regional_response: Kyiv and Moscow agreed mutual strike pause for US envoy safe passage, though Russia blocked American delegation flights. Israel sent police to Uman for Rosh Hashan security. Germany could not confirm Russian drone in Leipzig. Ukrainian prosecutors launched anti-corruption investigation into fraudulent call centers; Prosecutor General Kravchenko reported missing.
sections.intelligence_notes: Tu-95MS redeployment pattern suggests coordinated mass missile strike preparation. Multiple Banderol cruise missile tracks (Nizhyn, Romny, Putyvl, Zmiiv) indicate sustained precision strike campaign. Odesa border infrastructure attacks (ferry complex, Orlivka crossing) suggest disruption of logistics. VSU losses in Southern group zone warrant further confirmation. Israel's alleged secret operations in Ukraine including special forces training and drone tactics represent significant undisclosed involvement.
